threat_model.threat_source: Goal misspecification (a failure mode/process, not an intentional actor): 'Loss of control may arise due to goal misspecification (Rudner and Toner 2021).'
threat_model.objective_or_harmful_outcome: Harmful outcome only (no intention is stated for any actor): 'Loss of control' — a poorly specified or under-specified goal 'may be pursued in a way that humans did not intend.'
threat_model.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: The failure mode occurs 'when there are multiple interpretations of a goal, i.e., it is poorly specified or under-specified'; goal misspecification 'is the result of a fundamental difficulty in precisely defining what we find unacceptable in AI behavior'; and 'it unfortunately appears impossible to formally articulate the difference between morally right and wrong behavior without enumerating all the possible cases.'
threat_model.target_or_asset_at_risk: Control ('loss of control' may arise); the goal being pursued as humans intended (risk that it is 'pursued in a way that humans did not intend'); the desired ethical behavior of an AI that takes life-and-death decisions ('If an AI takes life-and-death decisions, we would like it to act ethically').
